taste:
This is a warm, smooth bowl of porridge with honey providing the sweetness. The oats are cooked until creamy, so the main appeal is their soft texture rather than any crisp or crunchy element. A generous drizzle of honey melts gently into the porridge, bringing a delicate sweet flavour to the traditional oat base.

Served steaming in a deep bowl, it is a comforting option when you want a gentle start to the morning. The rich texture gives it substance without turning it into a complicated breakfast. Choose it if warm oats and honey appeal more than a breakfast wrap or a traditional breakfast.
